Natural Language Query: Find the catalog publisher that has the most catalogs.
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT catalog_publisher
FROM Catalogs
GROUP BY catalog_publisher
ORDER BY COUNT(catalog_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

Natural Language Query: Find the names and publication dates of all catalogs that have catalog level number greater than 5.
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT catalog_name, date_of_publication 
FROM Catalogs 
WHERE catalog_id IN (
    SELECT catalog_id 
    FROM Catalog_Structure 
    WHERE catalog_level_number > 5
);

Natural Language Query: What are the entry names of catalog with the attribute possessed by most entries.
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT catalog_entry_name 
FROM Catalog_Contents 
WHERE catalog_entry_id IN (
    SELECT catalog_entry_id 
    FROM Catalog_Contents_Additional_Attributes 
    GROUP BY attribute_id 
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

Natural Language Query: Find the entry names of the catalog with the attribute that have the most entries.

FROM Catalog_Contents 
WHERE catalog_entry_id IN (
    SELECT catalog_entry_id 
    FROM Catalog_Contents_Additional_Attributes 
    GROUP BY attribute_id

Natural Language Query: What is the entry name of the most expensive catalog (in USD)?
Find the entry name of the catalog with the highest price (in USD).
What is the level name of the cheapest catalog (in USD)?
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT cs.catalog_level_name
FROM Catalog_Structure cs
JOIN Catalog_Contents cc ON cs.catalog_level_number = cc.catalog_level_number
WHERE cc.price_in_dollars = (SELECT MIN(price_in_dollars) FROM Catalog_Contents)

Natural Language Query: Find the level name of the catalog with the lowest price (in USD).
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT cs.catalog_level_name
FROM Catalog_Structure cs
JOIN Catalog_Contents cc ON cs.catalog_level_number = cc.catalog_level_number
WHERE cc.price_in_dollars = (SELECT MIN(price_in_dollars) FROM Catalog_Contents)

Natural Language Query: What are the average and minimum price (in Euro) of all products?
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT AVG(price_in_euros) AS average_price, MIN(price_in_euros) AS minimum_price
FROM Catalog_Contents;
